title: Pre-check file access via os.access (python) — review required
description: The python call os.access checks a file before use. An attacker swaps the file between check and use. This lexical rule flags the check; the reviewer opens atomically via try-open plus handle errors.
remediation: Open atomically with try-open plus handle errors.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any os.access call matches.
